title: 情報ネットワーク
subtitle: Information Networks
educationalGoal: This course introduces the knowledge and theory of TCP/IP protocols supporting the current Internet, and imparts various related communication technologies to students taking this course. Through this, students will gain an understanding of computer networks such as LAN and WAN to acquire basic skills related to network operations.
advice:
Students will systematically learn the basic knowledge and theories related to computer networks as shown below.

1. Basic mechanisms of computer networks
2. OSI reference model and TCP/IP
3. Physical layer and datalink layer
4. Network layer and transport layer
5. Routing protocol and application layer
requiredKnowledge: Basic knowledge and skills (binary number calculation, programming, etc.) related to first-year computer learning are required.

activityGoals.body: Be able to explain the basic mechanisms of computer networks.
Be able to explain the functions of each layer in the OSI reference model and TCP/IP protocols.
Be able to explain the basic mechanisms of the Internet.
Be able to perform network diagnostics using basic network commands and tools.

achievementLevels.ideal:
By the end of the course, students should be able to explain the following items systematically related to computer networks:

1. Basic information and communication systems
2. OSI reference model and TCP/IP models
3. Physical layer and datalink layer
4. Network layer and transport layer
5. Routing protocol and application layer

Additionally, students should be able to use appropriate network commands and tools for network maintenance and management.
achievementLevels.standard:
By the end of the course, students should be able to explain the basic contents of the following items related to computer networks:

1. Basic information and communication systems
2. OSI reference model and TCP/IP model
3. Physical layer and datalink layer
4. Network layer and transport layer
5. Routing protocol and application layer

Additionally, students should be able to use appropriate network commands and tools for basic network diagnostics.

lessons.content:
Overview for information & communication
network (Part 1):
Learn the history of various communication
technologies and protocol standardization.
lessons.assignments:
Review of lecture content
(history of information
network, etc.) and
preparation for Chapter 1
(basic network knowledge)
of the textbook.

lessons.content:
Overview for information & communication
network (Part 2):
Outline network technologies and usage
patterns in recent years and learn about their
relationship with this course.
lessons.assignments:
Review of lecture contents
(current network usage) and
preparation for Chapter 2
(basic knowledge of TCP/IP)
of the textbook.

lessons.content:
Fundamentals of TCP/IP:
Learn the basic principles of TCP/IP networks,
the mechanisms and roles of layering and
encapsulation using the OSI reference model,
coexistence of different models within a
network, and multiprotocol networks.
lessons.assignments:
Review of lecture contents
(OSI reference model and TCP/
IP), and preparation for
Chapter 3 (Datalink) of the
textbook.

lessons.content:
Datalink (Part 1):
Learn about datalink systems, MAC address,
Ethernet, etc.
lessons.assignments:
Review and preparation of
lecture contents
(various datalink systems).

lessons.content:
Datalink (Part 2):
Learn about wireless communication, PPP,
public access network, etc.
lessons.assignments:
Review of lecture contents
(various datalink systems),
and preparation for Chapter 4
(IP protocol) of the
textbook.

lessons.content:
IP protocol:
Learn about IP, IP address (IPv4/IPv6),
routing, IP segmentation and reconstruction.
lessons.assignments:
Review not only the basic
contents of IP and IP address
calculation.

lessons.content:
IP related technologies:
Learn about DNS, ARP, ICMP, DHCP, NAT, etc.
lessons.assignments:
Review of lecture contents
(IP-related technologies)
and preparation for Chapter 5
(Technologies related to IP)
of the textbook.

lessons.content:
Midterm Review:
Exam or exercises will be conducted to deepen
understanding of the content and exercises
relating to the lectures that have been given
thus far.
lessons.assignments:
Review of the contents of
the lectures learned in the
first half.
Preparation for Chapter 6 (TCP
 and UDP) of the
textbook.

lessons.content:
TCP and UDP (Part 1):
Learn about TCP, UDP, port number, window
control, retransmission control, flow control,
and congestion control.
lessons.assignments:
Review and preparation for
Chapter 6 (TCP and UDP) of
the textbook.

lessons.content:
TCP and UDP (Part 2):
Learn about TCP, UDP, port number, window
control, retransmission control, flow control,
and congestion control. Additionally,
exercises using these protocols will be
conducted.
lessons.assignments:
Review of Chapter 6
(TCP and UDP) and preparation
for Chapter 7
(Routing Protocol) of the
textbook.

lessons.content:
Routing Protocol:
Learn about static routing, dynamic routing,
and routing algorithms such as RIP and OSPF.
lessons.assignments:
Review of lecture contents
(Routing Protocol) and
preparation for Chapter 8
(Application Protocol) of the
textbook.

lessons.content:
Application Protocol:
Learn about the server-client communication
mechanism using the TCP/IP protocol and
actually use various protocols.
lessons.assignments:
Review of lecture contents
(various protocols in
Application layer) and
preparation for Chapter 9
(security) and appendix
(Physical layer) of the
textbook.

lessons.content:
Security and Appendix (Physical layer):
Learn about the importance of network security
in the Internet, its realization technologies
and physical layer.
lessons.assignments:
Review of lecture content and
review for final exam.

lessons.content:
General exercise and final exam of achievement
confirmation test:
Through lectures by external lecturers,
students will deepen their understanding of
what they have learned so far, and confirm
whether they have internalized the knowledge
and skills they have learned.
lessons.operation:
Lectures by external
lecturers & written exam
lessons.assignments:
Review what you have learned
so far.

lessons.content:
Self-evaluate achievement and general
exercise:
Review the returned answer-sheet and confirm
the level of understanding of the lecture.
Through exercises, students will deepen their
understanding of what they have learned.
